Upstream airmass (KJFK 75.2°F) confirms no cooler maritime push—advection potential zero. B76.5 at 99¢ NO and market pricing 80-81°F as near-50/50 both confirm consensus well above cap. Only 3 contracts available but position is clear.

Current temp 82.4F (28C), pace deficit 20F vs 98F ceiling with only ~4 hours of insolation left. S/SSE winds 13-17mps carry moist Gulf air (dewpoint 23C), positive dew differential suppresses wet-bulb ceiling. Upstream max only 87.8F; advection potential adds ~5F but deck blocks solar loading. Curve model peaks ~100F but requires clear-sky insolation that isn't happening. Market (B101.5 YES@45c) implies ~45% chance of exceeding 101F — inconsistent with current OVC suppression. Day runs warm but cap-clearing unlikely.
